purpose: Select one genuinely independent Campaign043 mechanism without reading minute candidate values, comparison values, daily prices, or historical returns.

candidate_queue_review.reason: It measures the scale-free agreement of active-bar transaction prices through a volume-weighted geometric-to-arithmetic mean ratio. It uses only amount and share volume, not close-return paths, high-low ranges, endpoint drift, market peers, disclosures, or any prior factor value.
Serial return constructions would re-express the terminal return autocorrelation, five-minute variance-ratio, transaction-price-path-confirmation, or spectral families.
A time-bin divergence would mix transaction-price dispersion with the already terminal amount entropy, amount center-of-mass, and market amount-profile mechanisms.
Adding close or high-low geometry would reopen terminal bar-VWAP pressure, transaction-VWAP envelope, intrabar close-location, or range mechanisms.
Unweighted moments, alternative centers, selected morning or afternoon windows, and fitted activity cutoffs would add an unfrozen family or parameter search.

The weighted geometric-to-arithmetic ratio already supplies an exact scale-free bounded statistic. Alternative transforms, thresholds, filters, or inverse directions would create immediate rescue paths.
Campaign043 is restricted to one raw mechanism with one fixed direction and no prior factor input, combination, fitted coefficient, regime, or model.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_transaction_vwap_consensus_240m
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: When completed-session trading volume clears near a common transaction-price level, the volume-weighted geometric and arithmetic mean transaction prices converge. Higher consensus may reflect orderly price discovery and lower unresolved inventory disagreement, potentially supporting stronger next-open-to-third-close performance.
selected_candidate.formula: For each active continuous-session bar i, let p_i=amount_i/volume_i and w_i=volume_i/sum_j(volume_j). Return exp(sum_i(w_i*log(p_i))) / sum_i(w_i*p_i).

decision.next_action: Complete a separate pre-value mechanism-overlap audit and bind the exact active-bar, zero, weighting, geometric/arithmetic mean, support, direction, endpoint, and forbidden-variant semantics before any candidate value is computed.
